newsitem.title: USA: North America bunkers mixed, Houston on rebound.
newsitem.headline: North America bunkers mixed, Houston on rebound.

text.p: North American bunker prices were mixed in moderate trade early this week, with Gulf Coast prices down but on the rebound, players said on Tuesday.
Houston 380 CST on the Gulf Coast worked its way back up from lows in the $96 a tonne range earlier this week to between $98 a tonne and $99 a tonne Tuesday.
The range is about $1 below values last Thursday.
"The lowest deal was at $96 in Houston and that was it. It bounced back up," said one Gulf Coast trader.
On the East Coast, New York Harbor bunkers were a little higher from last Thursday due largely to short supply.
